I couldn't find a class-diagram skill, so I built this by hand from the production sources. `NodeInternals` only has static methods, which it uses to attach source ranges. Seven production classes call it: `TreeBuilder`, `HtmlTreeBuilder`, `XmlTreeBuilder`, `HtmlTreeBuilderState`, `Token.Tag` and `Cleaner`. To show inheritance, the diagram also includes `LeafNode`, which is the link between `ProcessingInstruction` and `Node`.

```mermaid
classDiagram
    direction LR

    class NodeInternals {
        <<final>>
        -NodeInternals()
        +sourceRange(Node node, LineMap lineMap, int startPos, int endPos)$ void
        +endSourceRange(Element element, LineMap lineMap, int startPos, int endPos)$ void
        +clearEndSourceRange(Element element)$ void
        +sourceDataStart(ProcessingInstruction pi, int pos)$ void
        +attributeRange(Attributes attributes, String key, LineMap lineMap, int nameStart, int nameEnd, int valueStart, int valueEnd)$ void
        +attributeRange(Attributes attributes, String key, Range.AttributeRange range)$ void
    }

    %% ---- Types used by NodeInternals ----
    class Node {
        <<abstract>>
        ~spans() Range.Spans
        ~ensureSpans() Range.Spans
    }
    class LeafNode {
        <<abstract>>
    }
    class Element
    class ProcessingInstruction {
        ~sourceDataStart(int pos) void
    }
    class Attributes {
        ~NotFound$ int
        ~visibleIndexOfKey(String key) int
        ~spans() Range.Spans
        ~ensureSpans() Range.Spans
    }
    class LineMap {
        <<final>>
    }
    class Range
    class Range_Spans["Range.Spans"] {
        <<final>>
        ~sourceRange(LineMap, int, int) void
        ~endSourceRange(LineMap, int, int) void
        ~clearEndSourceRange() void
        ~attributeRange(int index, Range.AttributeRange range) void
        ~attributeRange(int index, LineMap, int, int, int, int) void
    }
    class Range_AttributeRange["Range.AttributeRange"] {
        +isTracked() boolean
    }
    class Validate {
        <<final>>
        +notNull(Object obj)$ void
    }

    %% ---- Types that use NodeInternals ----
    class TreeBuilder {
        <<abstract>>
    }
    class HtmlTreeBuilder
    class XmlTreeBuilder
    class HtmlTreeBuilderState {
        <<enumeration>>
    }
    class Token {
        <<abstract>>
    }
    class Token_Tag["Token.Tag"] {
        <<abstract>>
        ~finaliseAttributeRanges(ParseSettings settings) void
    }
    class Cleaner

    %% Inheritance / nesting
    Node <|-- Element
    Node <|-- LeafNode
    LeafNode <|-- ProcessingInstruction
    Range +-- Range_Spans
    Range +-- Range_AttributeRange
    TreeBuilder <|-- HtmlTreeBuilder
    TreeBuilder <|-- XmlTreeBuilder
    Token <|-- Token_Tag

    %% NodeInternals dependencies (outgoing)
    NodeInternals ..> Node : sourceRange
    NodeInternals ..> Element : endSourceRange / clearEndSourceRange
    NodeInternals ..> ProcessingInstruction : sourceDataStart
    NodeInternals ..> Attributes : attributeRange
    NodeInternals ..> LineMap : uses
    NodeInternals ..> Range_Spans : updates spans
    NodeInternals ..> Range_AttributeRange : copies
    NodeInternals ..> Validate : notNull

    %% Users of NodeInternals (incoming)
    TreeBuilder ..> NodeInternals : sourceRange / endSourceRange
    HtmlTreeBuilder ..> NodeInternals : sourceDataStart / clearEndSourceRange
    XmlTreeBuilder ..> NodeInternals : sourceDataStart
    HtmlTreeBuilderState ..> NodeInternals : attributeRange (copy)
    Token_Tag ..> NodeInternals : attributeRange (positions)
    Cleaner ..> NodeInternals : attributeRange (copy)

    %% Supporting relations among used types
    Attributes --> Range_Spans : spans
    Node ..> Attributes : spans via attributes()
```
